items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. Reject unsupported revenue, ROI, margin, payback, production, requeue, telemetry, spending, monetization, and launch claims. Continue only existing failure repair-or-close, measurement and attribution reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Keep private launch gates, parked-site dispositions, and external outreach unchanged. Owner: authorize any external permission request only after human-counsel review; otherwise keep it unsent.

Retain evidence-backed SEO, performance, UX, monetization, and repository opportunities as deferred backlog only. Do not queue or requeue implementation work until ownership, root cause, deduplication, deterministic validation, rollback, and measurement readiness are documented.

Continue the existing bounded security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve private launch gates; do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or conduct external outreach.

Continue existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed and retain revenue attribution, margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift as unknown.

Keep the gated product private, retain parked-site dispositions, and keep external outreach unsent. Continue only the existing rights, data-flow, consent, vendor, retention, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security evidence work.
